title.narrative: Building readiness and awareness for ethical neurotechnology

description.narrative: This workplan supports the Gulf countries and Yemen in implementing the Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology through a flexible, demand-driven approach. It allocates resources for a potential Readiness Assessment Methodology (RAM) in interested countries, while prioritizing the development of culturally relevant educational materials in Arabic and English. These materials will translate key ethical principles such as mental privacy, freedom of thought informed consent and inclusion, into practical guidance across themes including direct to consumer neurotechnology, and special users of neurotechnology such as persons with disabilities, children and adolescents. Complemented by regional workshops and capacity-building activities, the workplan aims to strengthen awareness, policy readiness, and ethical governance, while allowing adaptation based on country engagement and emerging needs.
